scope: Scientific and editorial verification of all substantive supporting sources cited in authored Markdown; local code, dictionaries, examples and frozen artifacts cross-checked. Historical search logs and generated results preserved.
limits: Targeted verification, not a new systematic search or exhaustive reference-chain review.
Relevant full-text sections inspected; no supplementary-file, formal risk-of-bias, or independent human duplicate review.
Current CDC metadata endpoint inaccessible and direct dataset page incomplete; local metadata are compact and do not fully define posted.
Sources screened out in historical logs are not supporting citations and were not reappraised.
Software tests do not establish operational, clinical, epidemiological, or source-authenticity validation.
